title: Need Something that Will Make a Splash

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Hey, hey, there boss. What's the good word?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, hey, there boss. What's the good word?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need your help with something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need your help with something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need your help with something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need your help with something.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Busy, busy, busy. Climbing that tower to the top, I hope. We'll be sittin' pretty if we keep expanding. You know, and all that other business talk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Busy, busy, busy. Climbing that tower to the top, I hope. We'll be sittin' pretty if we keep expanding. You know, and all that other business talk.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: We're making waves. Got ourselves some new promos to help get the word out. Pullin' in customers that would make the Corpsters cringe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're making waves. Got ourselves some new promos to help get the word out. Pullin' in customers that would make the Corpsters cringe.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: What about her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about her?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Alright. What side of the law we talkin'?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright. What side of the law we talkin'?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Ooof. She's a tough one. Prides herself on brand recognition. Making a splash with cleverly concocted cocktails.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ooof. She's a tough one. Prides herself on brand recognition. Making a splash with cleverly concocted cocktails.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Eh, they ain't my cuppa coffee but plenty of people seem to like them. Weird ingredients sometimes. Think that's her thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, they ain't my cuppa coffee but plenty of people seem to like them. Weird ingredients sometimes. Think that's her thing.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: This and that. Kinds of things you wouldn't think to put in a glass filled with ice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This and that. Kinds of things you wouldn't think to put in a glass filled with ice.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Oh, ugh, I mean, things are kinda busy here wouldn't yah say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, ugh, I mean, things are kinda busy here wouldn't yah say?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Aye, Captain. Guess I'll man the ship while you wage war.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aye, Captain. Guess I'll man the ship while you wage war.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: A raise wouldn't hurt. Just kidding. Though it wouldn't.... But while you think about that, give me a day or so. I'll see what I can scrounge up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A raise wouldn't hurt. Just kidding. Though it wouldn't.... But while you think about that, give me a day or so. I'll see what I can scrounge up.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: We're hosting everyone from crusty punks to hipsters.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're hosting everyone from crusty punks to hipsters.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: There's a moment you see it on a menu and wonder hmmm that might actually taste good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's a moment you see it on a menu and wonder hmmm that might actually taste good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You tell me! What's happening around here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You tell me! What's happening around here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You tell me! What's happening around here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You tell me! What's happening around here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You know that bar owner? Nola Berg?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know that bar owner? Nola Berg?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You know that bar owner? Nola Berg?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You know that bar owner? Nola Berg?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you always talking about hipsters? Anyway, I need your help with something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you always talking about hipsters? Anyway, I need your help with something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are you always talking about hipsters? Anyway, I need your help with something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are you always talking about hipsters? Anyway, I need your help with something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I might have pissed her off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I might have pissed her off.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I might have pissed her off.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I might have pissed her off.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have any dirt on her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have any dirt on her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You have any dirt on her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You have any dirt on her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never mind her brand, what about her drinks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never mind her brand, what about her drinks?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Never mind her brand, what about her drinks?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Never mind her brand, what about her drinks?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's legit... for now. You know the bar owner, Nola Berg?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's legit... for now. You know the bar owner, Nola Berg?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's legit... for now. You know the bar owner, Nola Berg?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's legit... for now. You know the bar owner, Nola Berg?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What kind of ingredients?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of ingredients?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wanna take her down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wanna take her down.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's why I hired the best.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's why I hired the best.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's why I hired the best.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's why I hired the best.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And this is how we're going to climb closer to the top.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And this is how we're going to climb closer to the top.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And this is how we're going to climb closer to the top.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And this is how we're going to climb closer to the top.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any suggestions on where to start?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any suggestions on where to start?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Any suggestions on where to start?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Any suggestions on where to start?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What customers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What customers?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then how is she successful?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then how is she successful?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The side we need to be on if we wanna take on Nola Berg.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The side we need to be on if we wanna take on Nola Berg.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The side we need to be on if we wanna take on Nola Berg.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The side we need to be on if we wanna take on Nola Berg.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: These cocktails. What's so special about them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: These cocktails. What's so special about them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: These cocktails. What's so special about them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: These cocktails. What's so special about them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's us or her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's us or her.
